                     na = c("", "NA", "NULL"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

# load data dictionary to paste into data README.md

food_access |>
  count(County) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

cbp <- read_csv("data/cbp_resp.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cbp |>
  filter(fiscal_year==2020) |>
  count(citizenship) |>
  arrange(n)
